versions.changelog:
- Initial release of product-ad-video skill.
- Converts a product still image into a short, high-polish ad or promo video using flagship image-to-video models.
- Supports both fresh video generation and swapping products into existing footage.
- Offers clear model selection guidance based on desired outcome (cinematic polish, speed, consistency).
- Provides detailed instructions for crafting prompts and matching video parameters.
- Outlines brand safety and quality requirements for generated ads.
